test-plan.md - SCHEMA.md - RUNBOOK.md --- # CI/CD Pipeline Design Document — ERP API Token Manager > **本文件描述** ERP API Token Manager（embedded ASP.NET Core 8 module）的持續整合（CI）與持續交付（CD）設計， > 涵蓋工具選型、Pipeline 架構、GitHub Actions Workflow 骨架、本地 Dry-Run 能力（act runner）、 > Shared Make Targets 模式（CI ↔ Local 對齊）、PR Gate、ArgoCD GitOps 部署、與本地開發者平台（Gitea）整合。 > > **CI Tool**: GitHub Actions（依 EDD §3.4 / RUNBOOK §1.1） > **CD Tool**: ArgoCD（GitOps） > **Design Principle**: CI 和 Local 使用相同 `make ci-*` targets，消除「本地 OK、CI 炸掉」問題。 --- ## Document Control | 欄位 | 值 | |------|---| | **CI 工具** | GitHub Actions（hosted runner: `ubuntu-latest`；本地以 `act` runner 模擬） | | **CD 工具** | ArgoCD（GitOps，watches Git for helm/kustomize 變更） | | **K8s Cluster（CI Agent）** | `ubuntu-latest`（GitHub-hosted）／ Rancher Desktop k3s（local act） | | **Production K8s Cluster** | `gke_erp-prod_asia-east1_erp-prod-cluster`（依 RUNBOOK §1.1） | | **Staging K8s Cluster** | `gke_erp-staging_asia-east1_erp-staging-cluster`（依 RUNBOOK §1.1） | | **Container Registry** | `ghcr.io/erp-org/erp-api-token-manager`（依 EDD §15.2 + RUNBOOK §1.1） | | **Source Repository** | `https://github.com/erp-org/erp-api-token-manager`（依 LOCAL_DEPLOY §21.2） | | **Branch Strategy** | GitHub Flow（`main` + 短期 `feature/*` branch + Pull Request；無長壽 develop branch） | | **PR Gate Policy** | 所有 §5 PR Gate stage 必須通過後方可合併至 `main`；`required_status_checks` enforced | | **K8S_NAMESPACE（local）** | `erp-token-local` | | **K8S_NAMESPACE（staging / prod）** | `erp-token-staging` / `erp-token-prod`（依 RUNBOOK §1.2） | | **Build Tool** | dotnet CLI（.NET 8 SDK），對應 image `mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0-jammy` | | **Migration Tool** | EF Core 8（`dotnet ef database update`）— 詳見 §4 ci-deploy 對應指令 | | **Author** | erp-org platform team | | **Last Updated** | 2026-05-08 | --- ## §1 Pipeline Architecture ### 1.1 GitHub Actions + ArgoCD 架構圖 ```mermaid graph TD subgraph Local["Local Machine（Rancher Desktop k3s）"] ActRunner["act runner

Integration Test（`make ci-test-integration`） 5. Image Build（Kaniko / docker build-push-action，no DinD） 6. Deploy to staging（`make ci-deploy`） 7. Smoke Test（`make ci-smoke`） `Deploy to Production` 為 stage 8（manual approval gate，依 EDD §15.1），不在 PR Gate 之內。 --- ## §2 Jenkinsfile 骨架 > **CI_TOOL = GitHub Actions**（依 EDD §3.4）。本節改用 `.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml` 骨架， > 取代模板預設的 Jenkinsfile。骨架對應 EDD §15.2 而後者為 source of truth。 ```yaml # .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml — ERP API Token Manager # 與 LOCAL_DEPLOY.md §21 act runner 設定對齊；所有 ci-* job 名稱需與 §5 required_status_checks 完全相同。 name: CI/CD Pipeline on: push: branches: [main] pull_request: branches: [main] env: REGISTRY: ghcr.io IMAGE_NAME: erp-org/erp-api-token-manager DOTNET_VERSION: "8.0.x" PROJECT_SLUG: erp-api-token-manager K8S_NAMESPACE_LOCAL: erp-token-local K8S_NAMESPACE_STAGING: erp-token-staging K8S_NAMESPACE_PROD: erp-token-prod permissions: contents: read packages: write id-token: write # 供 OIDC → cloud provider 短期憑證 jobs: # ── Stage 1: Build ──────────────────────────────────────────── build: name: build runs-on: ubuntu-latest timeout-minutes: 15 steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4 with: dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }} - name: Restore + Build run: make ci-build - name: Upload build artifacts uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: build-output path: | **/bin/Release/** !**/obj/** retention-days: 7 # ── Stage 2: Unit Test ───────────────────────────────────────── unit-test: name: unit-test runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: build timeout-minutes: 10 steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4 with: dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }} - name: Run unit tests run: make ci-test-unit - name: Publish JUnit results if: always() uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1 with: name: Unit Tests path: "**/TestResults/*.trx" reporter: dotnet-trx # ── Stage 3: Integration Test ────────────────────────────────── integration-test: name: integration-test runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: build timeout-minutes: 20 services: postgres: image: postgres:16-alpine env: POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }} POSTGRES_DB: erp_test ports: ["5432:5432"] options: >- --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5 steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4 with: dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }} - name: Run integration tests env: ConnectionStrings__ApiTokenDb: "Host=localhost;Database=erp_test;Username=postgres;Password=${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}" run: make ci-test-integration # ── Stage 4: Image Build（Kaniko，no DinD） ──────────────────── image-build: name: image-build runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: [unit-test, integration-test] if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'pull_request' timeout-minutes: 15 steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Login to GHCR uses: docker/login-action@v3 with: registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }} username: ${{ github.actor }} password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} - name: Build + push (rootless, no DinD) # buildx 使用 docker container driver；不需 privileged：true。 # 若需嚴格無 docker daemon，可切換至 docker/build-push-action + buildkit OR aquasecurity/kaniko-action。 uses: docker/build-push-action@v5 with: context: . file: docker/api/Dockerfile push: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }} tags: | ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }} ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest cache-from: type=registry,ref=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:buildcache cache-to: type=registry,ref=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:buildcache,mode=max # ── Stage 5: Deploy to staging（main only） ──────────────────── deploy-staging: name: deploy-staging runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: image-build if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' environment: staging timeout-minutes: 10 steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: kubectl context (staging) run: | echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_STAGING_B64 }}" | base64 -d > $HOME/.kube/config - name: Deploy + run EF Core migration env: IMAGE_TAG: ${{ github.sha }} run: make ci-deploy K8S_NAMESPACE=${{ env.K8S_NAMESPACE_STAGING }} CI_IMAGE_TAG=${IMAGE_TAG} # ── Stage 6: Smoke Test ──────────────────────────────────────── smoke-test: name: smoke-test runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: deploy-staging if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' timeout-minutes: 5 steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Smoke test against staging run: make ci-smoke K8S_NAMESPACE=${{ env.K8S_NAMESPACE_STAGING }} # ── Stage 7: Deploy to production（manual approval） ─────────── deploy-production: name: deploy-production runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: smoke-test if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' environment: name: production url: https://erp.internal/ApiTokens timeout-minutes: 10 steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: kubectl context (prod) run: | echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_PROD_B64 }}" | base64 -d > $HOME/.kube/config - name: Deploy + EF Core migration env: IMAGE_TAG: ${{ github.sha }} run: make ci-deploy K8S_NAMESPACE=${{ env.K8S_NAMESPACE_PROD }} CI_IMAGE_TAG=${IMAGE_TAG} # ── post: rollback on staging failure ────────────────────────── rollback-on-failure: name: rollback-on-failure runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: [deploy-staging, smoke-test] if: failure() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Rollback staging run: make ci-rollback K8S_NAMESPACE=${{ env.K8S_NAMESPACE_STAGING }} - name: Slack notify uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1 with: payload: | { "text": "🔴 staging deploy failed; rolled back. PR=${{ github.event.pull_request.html_url }}" } env: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }} ``` > **設計約束**： > - 任何 stage 不得使用 `services.docker:dind` 或 `--privileged` container（依 §10 Security）。 > - Image build 採用 `docker/build-push-action` 的 buildx + buildkit（rootless，預設無需 privileged）； > 若安全審查要求進一步無 docker daemon，可切換至 `aquasecurity/kaniko-action`。 > - 每個 job 必須設 `timeout-minutes` 防止 zombie run 吃額度。 > - `secrets.*` 必須事先在 GitHub repo Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions 設定，且不得明文出現於檔案中。 --- ## §3 Local Pipeline Dry-Run（act runner） ### 3.1 為何需要 Local Dry-Run 開發者在提交 PR 前應能在本地模擬完整 Pipeline 執行，避免「本地 OK、CI 炸掉」的問題： | 問題類型 | 發生率 | Local Dry-Run 可提前發現？ | |---------|-------|--------------------------| | Makefile target 語法錯誤 | 高 | ✅ 是（act 直接 invoke `make ci-*`） | | GitHub Actions YAML 語法錯誤 | 中 | ✅ 是（act 解析 workflow 後 fail-fast） | | Missing env vars / secrets | 高 | ✅ 是（以 `.secrets` mock 值執行） | | 測試在 CI 環境失敗 | 中 | ✅ 是（act 與 GH 同 image base） | | Runner image 不相容 | 低 | 部分（act 預設 `catthehacker/ubuntu:act-latest`，與 `ubuntu-latest` 行為近似） | ### 3.2 act 安裝（GitHub Actions 本地模擬） ```bash # 方式 A：Homebrew（推薦） brew install act # 方式 B：Curl 安裝 curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nektos/act/master/install.sh | bash -s -- -b ~/bin export PATH="$HOME/bin:$PATH" # 驗證 act --version # Expected: act version 0.2.x ``` > 本專案不安裝 Jenkins helm chart；GitHub Actions Workflow 由 GitHub-hosted runner 執行； > 本機只需 `act` + Docker socket（透過 Rancher Desktop 提供）即可重現 CI。 ### 3.3 Local Dry-Run 執行 ```bash # 方式 A：直接 act（推薦） # 對應 §2 workflow 路徑 .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml（與 §5 required_status_checks 引用一致） act push -W .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml --secret-file .secrets # 方式 B：模擬 Pull Request event act pull_request -W .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml --secret-file .secrets # 方式 C：透過 make target（推薦日常使用，與 §4 / LOCAL_DEPLOY §21.6 對齊） make ci-dry-run ``` ### 3.4 Mock Secrets 設定 ```bash # .secrets — act 本機 dry-run 用的假值（與 §10 Secret 表格對應的 mock 版本） # 已加入 .gitignore，不得進版控 cat > .secrets <<'EOF' DB_PASSWORD=ci-mock-db-password-not-real HMAC_SECRET=ci-mock-hmac-secret-not-real-64chars-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa DATA_PROTECTION_KEY=ci-mock-dp-key JWT_SECRET=ci-mock-jwt-secret-not-real-64chars-bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb REGISTRY_TOKEN=ci-mock-ghcr-token GITHUB_TOKEN=ci-mock-gh-token SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.slack.com/services/MOCK/MOCK/MOCK KUBECONFIG_STAGING_B64=bW9jay1rdWJlY29uZmlnLWZvci1hY3Q= KUBECONFIG_PROD_B64=bW9jay1rdWJlY29uZmlnLWZvci1hY3Q= EOF chmod 600 .secrets # 加入 .gitignore（若尚未加入） grep -qxF '.secrets' .gitignore || echo '.secrets' >> .gitignore ``` > **說明**：所有 `--env`/`--secret` 名稱 **必須涵蓋 §2 Workflow 中 `${{ secrets.* }}` 引用的所有 key** > （見 §10 Secret 表格）；若 §2 新增 secret 引用，本表須同步擴增，否則 `act` dry-run 會以 missing-secret 失敗。 --- ## §4 Shared Make Targets（CI ↔ Local 共用介面） > **設計原則**：CI Pipeline 和本地開發使用**相同的 Make targets**，消除「CI-as-snowflake」問題。 > 任何在 CI 上執行的操作，開發者在本地也能以相同命令執行。 > Target 命名與 LOCAL_DEPLOY.md §21.6 完全對齊（source of truth）。 ### 4.1 標準 Make Target 清單 > **註：** 本表新增 target 時須同步更新 [DEVELOPER_GUIDE §3.1 Quick Reference](./DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md) 與 [LOCAL_DEPLOY §6 Development Commands](./LOCAL_DEPLOY.md)（三處 SoT 共識）。 | Make Target | 說明 | CI 環境 | Local 環境 | |------------|------|---------|-----------| | `make ci-build` | `dotnet restore && dotnet build -c Release` | ✅ Stage: build | ✅ 開發者本地 | | `make ci-test-unit` | `dotnet test src/Application.Tests/` | ✅ Stage: unit-test | ✅ 開發者本地 | | `make ci-test-integration` | `dotnet test src/Infrastructure.IntegrationTests/`（Testcontainers + postgres:16） | ✅ Stage: integration-test | ✅ 開發者本地（需 Rancher Desktop / Docker socket）| | `make ci-build-image` | `nerdctl build` 或 `docker buildx build`，產出 `ghcr.io/erp-org/erp-api-token-manager:` | ✅ Stage: image-build | ✅ 開發者本地 | | `make ci-deploy` | `kubectl apply -k k8s/overlays/` + `dotnet ef database update` | ✅ Stage: deploy-staging / deploy-production | ✅ 開發者本地 k3s | | `make ci-smoke` | `curl -sf http://erp-token.local/health/ready` + 主流程 e2e | ✅ Stage: smoke-test | ✅ 開發者本地 | | `make ci-rollback` | `kubectl rollout undo deploy/erp-api-token-manager -n ` | ✅ rollback-on-failure job | ✅ 開發者本地緊急回滾 | | `make ci-dry-run` | `act push --secret-file .secrets` | ❌ 不在 CI 執行 | ✅ 開發者本地 | > 上表 8 個 target 與 LOCAL_DEPLOY.md §21.6 一致；若新增/重新命名 target，**必須同步更新 LOCAL_DEPLOY.md §21.6 與本表**。 ### 4.2 Makefile 完整實作 ```makefile # CI/CD Make targets — ERP API Token Manager # 所有 ci-* targets 必須在 CI 與本地環境均可執行。 # 對應 LOCAL_DEPLOY.md §21.6 與 §6 Development Commands。 PROJECT_SLUG ?= erp-api-token-manager CONTAINER_REGISTRY ?= ghcr.io/erp-org CI_IMAGE_TAG ?= local-$(shell git rev-parse --short HEAD) K8S_NAMESPACE ?= erp-token-local DEPLOY_NAME ?= erp-api-token-manager HEALTH_URL ?= http://erp-token.local/health/ready .PHONY: ci-build ci-test-unit ci-test-integration ci-build-image \ ci-deploy ci-smoke ci-rollback ci-dry-run ci-build: dotnet restore dotnet build -c Release --no-restore /p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=true @echo "✅ Build complete" ci-test-unit: dotnet test src/Application.Tests/Application.Tests.csproj \ --no-build --configuration Release \ --logger "trx;LogFileName=unit.trx" \ --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" @echo "✅ Unit tests passed" ci-test-integration: # Testcontainers 需 Docker / nerdctl socket 可達 dotnet test src/Infrastructure.IntegrationTests/Infrastructure.IntegrationTests.csproj \ --no-build --configuration Release \ --logger "trx;LogFileName=integration.trx" @echo "✅ Integration tests passed" ci-build-image: nerdctl --namespace=k8s.io build \ -t $(CONTAINER_REGISTRY)/$(PROJECT_SLUG):$(CI_IMAGE_TAG) \ -t $(CONTAINER_REGISTRY)/$(PROJECT_SLUG):latest \ -f docker/api/Dockerfile . @echo "✅ Image built: $(CI_IMAGE_TAG)" ci-deploy: # Step 1：apply manifest kubectl apply -k k8s/overlays/$(notdir $(K8S_NAMESPACE)) # Step 2：set image kubectl set image deployment/$(DEPLOY_NAME) \ app=$(CONTAINER_REGISTRY)/$(PROJECT_SLUG):$(CI_IMAGE_TAG) \ -n $(K8S_NAMESPACE) # Step 3：wait for rollout kubectl rollout status deployment/$(DEPLOY_NAME) -n $(K8S_NAMESPACE) --timeout=180s # Step 4：EF Core migration（依 SCHEMA.md §0.1 EF Core 為唯一 migration tooling） kubectl exec -n $(K8S_NAMESPACE) deploy/$(DEPLOY_NAME) -- \ dotnet ef database update --no-build @echo "✅ Deployed $(CI_IMAGE_TAG) to namespace $(K8S_NAMESPACE) + migration applied" ci-smoke: @for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do \ curl -sf $(HEALTH_URL) > /dev/null && { echo "✅ /health/ready responding"; exit 0; }; \ echo "Retry $$i / 5 ..."; sleep 5; \ done; echo "❌ smoke failed"; exit 1 ci-rollback: kubectl rollout undo deployment/$(DEPLOY_NAME) -n $(K8S_NAMESPACE) kubectl rollout status deployment/$(DEPLOY_NAME) -n $(K8S_NAMESPACE) --timeout=120s @echo "⚠️ Rolled back to previous version in namespace $(K8S_NAMESPACE)" ci-dry-run: @command -v act >/dev/null || { echo "❌ act not installed; brew install act"; exit 1; } @test -f .secrets || { echo "❌ .secrets not found; see CICD §3.4"; exit 1; } act push -W .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml --secret-file .secrets ``` > **重要**：`ci-deploy` target 中 EF Core migration 指令源於 SCHEMA.md §0.1（"EF Core Migrations 為本專案唯一 migration 工具； > 不採用 Flyway / Liquibase / golang-migrate"），不得替換為其他工具。 --- ## §5 PR Gate 所有 Pull Request 必須通過以下 GitHub Actions jobs（與 §4 stage 名稱一一對應）後方可合併至 `main` 分支。 ### 5.1 PR Gate 清單 | Stage / job 名稱 | 必須通過 | 允許跳過條件 | |------------------|---------|------------| | `build`（`make ci-build`） | ✅ 必須 | 無 | | `unit-test`（`make ci-test-unit`） | ✅ 必須 | 無 | | `integration-test`（`make ci-test-integration`） | ✅ 必須 | 無 | | `image-build` | ⚠️ main / PR 至 main 必須 | `[skip-image]` commit prefix（hot-fix 除外） | | `deploy-staging` | ⚠️ 僅 push to main 觸發 | N/A（PR 階段不執行） | | `smoke-test` | ⚠️ 僅 push to main 觸發 | N/A | | Security Scan（NuGet vulnerable / Trivy）| ✅ 必須（依 §10） | 無 | ### 5.2 Branch Protection Rules（GitHub） ```yaml # CI_TOOL = GitHub Actions（依 EDD §3.4）。本節改用 .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml 骨架，

取代模板預設的 Jenkinsfile。骨架對應 EDD §15.2 而後者為 source of truth。

# .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml — ERP API Token Manager
# 與 LOCAL_DEPLOY.md §21 act runner 設定對齊；所有 ci-* job 名稱需與 §5 required_status_checks 完全相同。
name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: erp-org/erp-api-token-manager
  DOTNET_VERSION: "8.0.x"
  PROJECT_SLUG: erp-api-token-manager
  K8S_NAMESPACE_LOCAL: erp-token-local
  K8S_NAMESPACE_STAGING: erp-token-staging
  K8S_NAMESPACE_PROD: erp-token-prod

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write
  id-token: write   # 供 OIDC → cloud provider 短期憑證

jobs:
  # ── Stage 1: Build ────────────────────────────────────────────
  build:
    name: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}
      - name: Restore + Build
        run: make ci-build
      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: |
            **/bin/Release/**
            !**/obj/**
          retention-days: 7

  # ── Stage 2: Unit Test ─────────────────────────────────────────
  unit-test:
    name: unit-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: make ci-test-unit
      - name: Publish JUnit results
        if: always()
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: Unit Tests
          path: "**/TestResults/*.trx"
          reporter: dotnet-trx

  # ── Stage 3: Integration Test ──────────────────────────────────
  integration-test:
    name: integration-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    timeout-minutes: 20
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}
          POSTGRES_DB: erp_test
        ports: ["5432:5432"]
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}
      - name: Run integration tests
        env:
          ConnectionStrings__ApiTokenDb: "Host=localhost;Database=erp_test;Username=postgres;Password=${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}"
        run: make ci-test-integration

  # ── Stage 4: Image Build（Kaniko，no DinD） ────────────────────
  image-build:
    name: image-build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [unit-test, integration-test]
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Login to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Build + push (rootless, no DinD)
        # buildx 使用 docker container driver；不需 privileged：true。
        # 若需嚴格無 docker daemon，可切換至 docker/build-push-action + buildkit OR aquasecurity/kaniko-action。
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: docker/api/Dockerfile
          push: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
          tags: |
            ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }}
            ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest
          cache-from: type=registry,ref=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:buildcache
          cache-to: type=registry,ref=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:buildcache,mode=max

  # ── Stage 5: Deploy to staging（main only） ────────────────────
  deploy-staging:
    name: deploy-staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: image-build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment: staging
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: kubectl context (staging)
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_STAGING_B64 }}" | base64 -d > $HOME/.kube/config
      - name: Deploy + run EF Core migration
        env:
          IMAGE_TAG: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: make ci-deploy K8S_NAMESPACE=${{ env.K8S_NAMESPACE_STAGING }} CI_IMAGE_TAG=${IMAGE_TAG}

  # ── Stage 6: Smoke Test ────────────────────────────────────────
  smoke-test:
    name: smoke-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy-staging
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Smoke test against staging
        run: make ci-smoke K8S_NAMESPACE=${{ env.K8S_NAMESPACE_STAGING }}

  # ── Stage 7: Deploy to production（manual approval） ───────────
  deploy-production:
    name: deploy-production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: smoke-test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://erp.internal/ApiTokens
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: kubectl context (prod)
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_PROD_B64 }}" | base64 -d > $HOME/.kube/config
      - name: Deploy + EF Core migration
        env:
          IMAGE_TAG: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: make ci-deploy K8S_NAMESPACE=${{ env.K8S_NAMESPACE_PROD }} CI_IMAGE_TAG=${IMAGE_TAG}

  # ── post: rollback on staging failure ──────────────────────────
  rollback-on-failure:
    name: rollback-on-failure
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [deploy-staging, smoke-test]
    if: failure() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Rollback staging
        run: make ci-rollback K8S_NAMESPACE=${{ env.K8S_NAMESPACE_STAGING }}
      - name: Slack notify
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1
        with:
          payload: |
            { "text": "🔴 staging deploy failed; rolled back. PR=${{ github.event.pull_request.html_url }}" }
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}

設計約束：

- 任何 stage 不得使用 services.docker:dind 或 --privileged container（依 §10 Security）。

- Image build 採用 docker/build-push-action 的 buildx + buildkit（rootless，預設無需 privileged）；

若安全審查要求進一步無 docker daemon，可切換至 aquasecurity/kaniko-action。

- 每個 job 必須設 timeout-minutes 防止 zombie run 吃額度。

- secrets.* 必須事先在 GitHub repo Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions 設定，且不得明文出現於檔案中。

§3 Local Pipeline Dry-Run（act runner）

3.1 為何需要 Local Dry-Run

開發者在提交 PR 前應能在本地模擬完整 Pipeline 執行，避免「本地 OK、CI 炸掉」的問題：

問題類型發生率Local Dry-Run 可提前發現？
Makefile target 語法錯誤高✅ 是（act 直接 invoke make ci-*）
GitHub Actions YAML 語法錯誤中✅ 是（act 解析 workflow 後 fail-fast）
Missing env vars / secrets高✅ 是（以 .secrets mock 值執行）
測試在 CI 環境失敗中✅ 是（act 與 GH 同 image base）
Runner image 不相容低部分（act 預設 catthehacker/ubuntu:act-latest，與 ubuntu-latest 行為近似）

3.2 act 安裝（GitHub Actions 本地模擬）

# 方式 A：Homebrew（推薦）
brew install act

# 方式 B：Curl 安裝
curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nektos/act/master/install.sh | bash -s -- -b ~/bin
export PATH="$HOME/bin:$PATH"

# 驗證
act --version
# Expected: act version 0.2.x

本專案不安裝 Jenkins helm chart；GitHub Actions Workflow 由 GitHub-hosted runner 執行；

本機只需 act + Docker socket（透過 Rancher Desktop 提供）即可重現 CI。

3.3 Local Dry-Run 執行

# 方式 A：直接 act（推薦）
# 對應 §2 workflow 路徑 .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml（與 §5 required_status_checks 引用一致）
act push -W .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml --secret-file .secrets

# 方式 B：模擬 Pull Request event
act pull_request -W .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml --secret-file .secrets

# 方式 C：透過 make target（推薦日常使用，與 §4 / LOCAL_DEPLOY §21.6 對齊）
make ci-dry-run

§4 Shared Make Targets（CI ↔ Local 共用介面）

設計原則：CI Pipeline 和本地開發使用相同的 Make targets，消除「CI-as-snowflake」問題。

任何在 CI 上執行的操作，開發者在本地也能以相同命令執行。

Target 命名與 LOCAL_DEPLOY.md §21.6 完全對齊（source of truth）。

4.2 Makefile 完整實作

# CI/CD Make targets — ERP API Token Manager
# 所有 ci-* targets 必須在 CI 與本地環境均可執行。
# 對應 LOCAL_DEPLOY.md §21.6 與 §6 Development Commands。

PROJECT_SLUG       ?= erp-api-token-manager
CONTAINER_REGISTRY ?= ghcr.io/erp-org
CI_IMAGE_TAG       ?= local-$(shell git rev-parse --short HEAD)
K8S_NAMESPACE      ?= erp-token-local
DEPLOY_NAME        ?= erp-api-token-manager
HEALTH_URL         ?= http://erp-token.local/health/ready

.PHONY: ci-build ci-test-unit ci-test-integration ci-build-image \
        ci-deploy ci-smoke ci-rollback ci-dry-run

ci-build:
	dotnet restore
	dotnet build -c Release --no-restore /p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=true
	@echo "✅ Build complete"

ci-test-unit:
	dotnet test src/Application.Tests/Application.Tests.csproj \
	  --no-build --configuration Release \
	  --logger "trx;LogFileName=unit.trx" \
	  --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"
	@echo "✅ Unit tests passed"

ci-test-integration:
	# Testcontainers 需 Docker / nerdctl socket 可達
	dotnet test src/Infrastructure.IntegrationTests/Infrastructure.IntegrationTests.csproj \
	  --no-build --configuration Release \
	  --logger "trx;LogFileName=integration.trx"
	@echo "✅ Integration tests passed"

ci-build-image:
	nerdctl --namespace=k8s.io build \
	  -t $(CONTAINER_REGISTRY)/$(PROJECT_SLUG):$(CI_IMAGE_TAG) \
	  -t $(CONTAINER_REGISTRY)/$(PROJECT_SLUG):latest \
	  -f docker/api/Dockerfile .
	@echo "✅ Image built: $(CI_IMAGE_TAG)"

ci-deploy:
	# Step 1：apply manifest
	kubectl apply -k k8s/overlays/$(notdir $(K8S_NAMESPACE))
	# Step 2：set image
	kubectl set image deployment/$(DEPLOY_NAME) \
	  app=$(CONTAINER_REGISTRY)/$(PROJECT_SLUG):$(CI_IMAGE_TAG) \
	  -n $(K8S_NAMESPACE)
	# Step 3：wait for rollout
	kubectl rollout status deployment/$(DEPLOY_NAME) -n $(K8S_NAMESPACE) --timeout=180s
	# Step 4：EF Core migration（依 SCHEMA.md §0.1 EF Core 為唯一 migration tooling）
	kubectl exec -n $(K8S_NAMESPACE) deploy/$(DEPLOY_NAME) -- \
	  dotnet ef database update --no-build
	@echo "✅ Deployed $(CI_IMAGE_TAG) to namespace $(K8S_NAMESPACE) + migration applied"

ci-smoke:
	@for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do \
	  curl -sf $(HEALTH_URL) > /dev/null && { echo "✅ /health/ready responding"; exit 0; }; \
	  echo "Retry $$i / 5 ..."; sleep 5; \
	done; echo "❌ smoke failed"; exit 1

ci-rollback:
	kubectl rollout undo deployment/$(DEPLOY_NAME) -n $(K8S_NAMESPACE)
	kubectl rollout status deployment/$(DEPLOY_NAME) -n $(K8S_NAMESPACE) --timeout=120s
	@echo "⚠️ Rolled back to previous version in namespace $(K8S_NAMESPACE)"

ci-dry-run:
	@command -v act >/dev/null || { echo "❌ act not installed; brew install act"; exit 1; }
	@test -f .secrets || { echo "❌ .secrets not found; see CICD §3.4"; exit 1; }
	act push -W .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml --secret-file .secrets

重要：ci-deploy target 中 EF Core migration 指令源於 SCHEMA.md §0.1（"EF Core Migrations 為本專案唯一 migration 工具；

不採用 Flyway / Liquibase / golang-migrate"），不得替換為其他工具。

§5 PR Gate

所有 Pull Request 必須通過以下 GitHub Actions jobs（與 §4 stage 名稱一一對應）後方可合併至 main 分支。

5.1 PR Gate 清單

Stage / job 名稱必須通過允許跳過條件
build（make ci-build）✅ 必須無
unit-test（make ci-test-unit）✅ 必須無
integration-test（make ci-test-integration）✅ 必須無
image-build⚠️ main / PR 至 main 必須[skip-image] commit prefix（hot-fix 除外）
deploy-staging⚠️ 僅 push to main 觸發N/A（PR 階段不執行）
smoke-test⚠️ 僅 push to main 觸發N/A
Security Scan（NuGet vulnerable / Trivy）✅ 必須（依 §10）無

5.2 Branch Protection Rules（GitHub）

# .github/branch-protection.yml（參考設定，實際需在 GitHub UI / API 套用）
repository: erp-org/erp-api-token-manager
branches:
  - name: main
    protection:
      required_status_checks:
        strict: true
        contexts:
          - "build"
          - "unit-test"
          - "integration-test"
          - "image-build"
      required_pull_request_reviews:
        required_approving_review_count: 1
        dismiss_stale_reviews: true
        require_code_owner_reviews: true
      enforce_admins: true
      required_linear_history: true

注意：contexts 中的名稱必須與 §2 workflow 中 jobs.<job>.name 完全一致（GitHub Actions 用 name

作為 status check context；若未設 name，則用 <workflow>/<job-id>）。本專案所有 job 都顯式設定 name: <id>

確保 context 與 §4 Make Target stage 名稱完全對應，避免 R-04 finding。

5.3 開發者 Pre-PR Checklist

開發者在 PR 前自行於本機執行：

# 1. 確認本地 build 通過
make ci-build

# 2. 確認單元測試通過

# 3. 確認整合測試通過（需 Rancher Desktop up）

# 4. 確認 BDD scenarios 通過（test-plan §3.3 要求）

make test-bdd-client

# 5. 模擬完整 Pipeline

# 6. 確認 workflow 無裸 placeholder
grep -E '\{\{[A-Z_]+\}\}' .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml && echo "⚠️ 有 placeholder 未替換" || echo "✅ 無裸 placeholder"

# 7. 確認所有檔案無明文 credential（regex 對照 §10）
grep -REn 'password\s*=\s*[^${\$]' .github/workflows/ Makefile k8s/ && echo "⚠️ 發現潛在明文 credential" || echo "✅ 無明文 credential"

  --docker-password="$(security find-generic-password -w -s 'erp-api-token-manager-registry' -a dev)" \
  -n erp-token-local-jenkins

macOS Keychain 讀取；Windows 開發者請使用 LOCAL_DEPLOY §3.5 的 bootstrap-secrets.ps1 等價步驟。

在 GitHub Actions（hosted runner）路徑下，此 secret 由 secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN 自動提供，

無需建立 K8s secret——本步驟僅在 self-hosted fallback 時使用。

§7 ArgoCD CD Integration（GitOps）

7.1 ArgoCD 安裝（Local / Staging / Production）

# 安裝 ArgoCD
kubectl create namespace argocd
kubectl apply -n argocd \
  -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/stable/manifests/install.yaml

# 等待就緒
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pods --all -n argocd --timeout=180s

# 取得初始 admin password（CLI）
argocd admin initial-password -n argocd
# 或從 secret 讀
kubectl -n argocd get secret argocd-initial-admin-secret \
  -o jsonpath="{.data.password}" | base64 -d; echo

7.2 ArgoCD Application 定義

# k8s/argocd/app.yaml（staging / production 共用模板，DEPLOY_ENV 變數差異）
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: erp-api-token-manager-staging   # 或 erp-api-token-manager-prod
  namespace: argocd
spec:
  project: default
  source:
    # Production / Staging：repoURL: https://github.com/erp-org/erp-api-token-manager
    # LOCAL mode（Rancher Desktop）：repoURL: http://gitea.dev-tools.svc.cluster.local:3000/dev/erp-api-token-manager.git
    repoURL: https://github.com/erp-org/erp-api-token-manager
    targetRevision: main
    path: k8s/overlays/staging   # 或 k8s/overlays/production
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: erp-token-staging   # 或 erp-token-prod
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: true
      selfHeal: true
    syncOptions:
      - CreateNamespace=true
      - ServerSideApply=true

sequenceDiagram
